description:
A library that calibrates application software to the combination of the barcode scanner configuration and OS keyboard layout.

		Latest Release Notes:
		--------------
		
		The following changes were made in this release.

		1) Implemented support for detecting issues with EOT characters.
		2) Improved handling for ASCII control characters used in ISO/IEC 15434 messages.
